exclusion_reason: The public compatibility database export is implemented: every row must carry a declared evidence field, an unbacked or personal-data row is refused, and the export is deterministic byte-stable across runs. The benchmark stays red because generating a live compatibility session to back the rows needs the absent recording/runtime path (BPTK-028).
promotion_trigger: Promote when the export is byte-stable across regeneration and every row resolves to evidence with no unbacked or personal-data row.
active_gate_evidence: test/governance.test.mjs asserts the export hash and body are identical across two runs, and that an evidence-less row and a personal-data row are each refused.
procedure: Generate the export twice from the same evidence and compare bytes.
Assert every row carries the declared evidence field.
Attempt an unbacked and a personal-data row and assert refusal.
pass_criterion: No unbacked or personal row is accepted.
